categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Build system' and modifies depends build system files ('depends/funcs.mk' and 'depends/packages.md').
categories.rationale: Prevents silent build corruption when multiple checkouts share a common source directory. Without this hash isolation, 'that directory silently builds from the wrong sources' if a local package tarball created by one worktree is newer than files in another.
